Raid Day

Clefable Super Mega Raid Day

Sat, Nov 28, 2026, 2:00 PM → Sat, Nov 28, 2026, 5:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

Mega Clefable makes its Pokémon GO debut in Super Mega Raids on Saturday, Nov 28, from 2 to 5 p.m. local time.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Raids

  • Mega Clefable (Fairy/Flying) appears in Super Mega Raids during the event.
  • Beating it gives a Clefable encounter with Mega Level 1 already unlocked.
  • Shiny Clefable can be found; the odds haven't been published.

Global Challenge

  • A worldwide challenge runs from Friday, Nov 27, 5 p.m. PST to Saturday, Nov 28, 8 p.m. PST. The more tiers players complete together, the bigger the Mega Clefable bonus.

Tickets

  • A paid event ticket adds extra bonuses. It's sold in the game until 5 p.m. local time on Nov 28, and as an Ultra Ticket Box in the Pokémon GO Web Store, which also includes a Premium Battle Pass.

Tip

Mega Clefable is Fairy and Flying, so Steel attackers are your best counters, and Poison and Electric types also hit it hard.
